contentHtml:
Toshiba Repairs Stretton

Toshiba delivers a wide variety of laptops and notebooks ranging from 12-inch personal computers up to 18-inch gaming system. Toshiba is considered to be one of the top sellers in Australia market. Because of being famous in the industry of laptop computers, we get to receive plenty of Toshiba repair jobs from our customers in Stretton and nearby Brisbane suburbs. Our extensive experience in repairing Toshiba laptops gives us the better understanding of what are the most common issues with this computer brand. The most common problem we encounter are overheating CPU and GPU mainly because of faulty heat sinks and poor quality ventilation or fan.

Computer Repairs Stretton offers unparalleled repair service for all kinds of Toshiba laptop models. If you have a problem with your Toshiba computer, make sure you bring it to an expert repair technician who has the knowledge and experience to get the job done quickly and effectively.

Our high quality Toshiba computer repairs Stretton services

Toshiba DC jack repair and replacement, Having a loose laptop DC jack can be a big problem for making your laptop up and capable of charging. Our experts can repair or replace your computer’s DC jack to ensure that you can use your computer comfortably again. We offer the best repair service for Toshiba in Stretton.

Toshiba motherboard repair, The motherboard is what makes up the software and hardware functionalities of your computer. When your motherboard is damaged, your computer won’t be able to function properly. Our experts at Computer Repairs Stretton can repair or replace your motherboard so that your computer runs smoothly.

Toshiba LCD repair and replacement, Broken or damaged LCD screen that renders your Toshiba laptop almost not comfortable to use, consider having a replacement. Just give us a call and we will be right at your service!

Toshiba backlight repair and replacement, Does fainted display of your laptop screen bothers you and starting to affect your productivity? Do not risk losing any more productivity, give us a call and we will have your display screen fixed and clear as new.

Toshiba laptop keyboard repair and replacement, Our experts at Computer Repairs Stretton can provide all kinds of repairs and services for your Toshiba computer with the mission to provide the best services in all of Brisbane! So whether you spilled coffee all over your keyboard or some keys won’t work, rest assured our experts can handle it.

Toshiba touch-pad replacement, Touch-pad won’t work? You might need to consider having your touch-pad checked, repaired or replaced. Bring your computer to our workshop and we will be glad to help you.

Toshiba inverter repair, Does your laptop display seems too dark and making it hard to see images with the right tone and colors? We can have your display inverter checked and repaired. Call Computer Repairs Stretton, we offer nothing but the best and most affordable computer repairs and services in all of Brisbane.

We would always love to help you on fixing any of your computer problems regardless how big or small. At Computer Repairs Stretton, you can guarantee that you will get a service of a professional technician who is fast, polite, punctual and certified with skills. We are committed in giving you the opportunity to save your time and money. Call us now at 0477 319 160 with no call out fees and have out experts assess your computer problems quickly, provide you an affordable cost and get the job done right.

Toshiba virus and spyware removal, If you are looking for the most effective virus and malware removal in Stretton or Brisbane, you are in the right place. Our experts offer a dedicated service for malicious software removal for your PC making it 100% clean from any computer viruses.

Toshiba PC and laptop upgrades , We get a lot of customers wanting to boost the performance of their Toshiba laptop specially the Ultrabook and gaming models. Our workshop provides complete upgrade services for your specific requirement and needs.

  • Optimization
  • Hardware installation
  • RAM upgrade
  • Storage upgrade
  • CPU upgrade
  • Computer tune-up
  • Operating system install and updates
  • Performance speedup
  • Computer restore and reformatting

Toshiba internet and network setup, Computer Repairs Stretton also provides solution for your network problems including Wi-Fi setup, wired setup, cable setup, network configuration and even internet security concerns.

Toshiba data and file recovery, Trying to recover a lost data can be really stressful. Our expert technicians are capable of recovering lost files, accidentally deleted data, system recovery, data backup or restore and even forgotten computer passwords.

Other hardware repairs for Toshiba

  • Toshiba laptop not turning on
  • Toshiba laptop LCD screen is dim or dark
  • Display only visible on external monitor but not visible on laptop LCD screen
  • Toshiba laptop LCD screen not turning on
  • Toshiba laptop LCD screen is cracked
  • Toshiba laptop GPU or graphics card problem and distorted display
  • Toshiba laptop motherboard failure
  • Toshiba laptop power supply repairs
  • Toshiba loose or broken hinge replacement
  • Toshiba LED and CCFL bulb replacement
  • Toshiba Laptop Optical Drive Upgrade/Replacement (DVD-RW, DVD Burners)
  • Toshiba AC/DC power jack repairs
  • Toshiba memory upgrades
  • Toshiba replacement of broken or cracked plastic parts (LCD cover and base cover)
  • Toshiba liquid spill repairs (Cola, Water, Coffee, Tea, Wine, Etc.)
  • Toshiba internal dust and particles cleaning
  • Toshiba component level motherboard repairs

Other software repairs for Toshiba

  • Toshiba laptop data and file backup services
  • Transfer of data to your new hard drive or Toshiba computer
  • Solutions for slow working Toshiba laptops
  • Solutions and repairs for Blue Screen of Deaths (BSODs) and freezing symptoms
  • Laptop driver installation for Toshiba

Custom built computer, We can modify and upgrade your Toshiba computer to your heart’s desire! Just give us the right specifications and we will make sure you have a brand new custom built computer in no time.

Ways to avail our expert repair services

Workshop, You are always welcome to visit our workshop any day of the week, Monday to Sunday from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Bring your computer to us and our experts will provide you a comprehensive diagnostic and the budget friendly repair cost. Make sure you call us at 0477 319 160 prior to your visit.

Onsite computer repair, If you are having difficulties to travel with your computer, do not worry. We can send our expert technician to provide our repair service at the convenience of your own place. Just call us and let us know your computer problems and we will be on our way to help you, with no call out fees or travel fees!

Remote services, For computer repairs that can be easily fixed by remotely logging in to your computer, we can also help. You just need to download a special software and allow us to access your computer. Saving you form travelling and you can even watch us fix your computer problems.
